name: base_utils
description: Manages common host utilities, including optional MOTD configuration and installation of Hiera-provided utility packages, with supporting custom types, functions, facts, plans, tasks, and templates.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Provisions a full Python application stack with dependencies, PostgreSQL-backed application setup, Git or local-source deployment, environment configuration, systemd service management, monitoring, and log rotation.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures an HAProxy load balancer, including packages, generated configuration, backend discovery, service management, firewall integration, statistics, logging, TLS settings, and structured backends.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL using the PGDG repository, pinned packages, and service enablement and startup management.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs and configures Redis with password protection, persistence, memory limits, and intended PuppetDB-based node discovery.

name: profile
description: Composes nested base, application, cache, and load-balancer profiles to define the site-level configuration boundary used by roles.

name: role
description: Provides node-level orchestration for application, HAProxy, and Redis roles, applying the base profile before service-specific profiles and defining Linux command path defaults.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Provides a supporting custom Puppet function library for PuppetDB queries used by the Redis profile's discovery mechanism.
